Bitcoin is ~$82.7k, 34% below its October 2025 high. ETFs took in $6.3bn in Q3 yet are only ~$1bn up for the year.

In this regime it trades as the longest-duration risk asset, not a hedge: hurt by every pressure on the table except oil.

tweets.author: chapraandco.bsky.social
tweets.text:
The last three midterm Q4s with a Fed hike: −0.7% in 1994, −14.0% in 2018, +7.1% in 2022. Bitcoin fell 43.9% and 14.9% in the two it lived through.

The calendar is not the variable. Where the quarter started is.
